title: Type every interlocking message payload

facts.note: Source subject_kind is 'interlocking'; no artifact observer that identifies interlocking subjects (by path or kind) is established, so a subject-kind observer is needed.
Validation runs at CONFIRM and is confirm-blocking; the phase must be supplied by the harness. Applies to every message in the interlocking regardless of whether it was changed.

fires: CONFIRM is reached for a plan containing an interlocking that has at least one message, including messages that were not added or edited in the current change (the check then evaluates each message for payload.contract or payload.no_payload_reason)
doesNotFire: The subject being validated is not an interlocking (no interlocking subject present)

given: An interlocking contains messages (newly authored or pre-existing)
when: The interlocking is taken to CONFIRM
then: Every interlocking message declares either payload.contract or an explicit payload.no_payload_reason.
prefer: Set payload.contract to the contract that types the data the message carries
When the message carries no data, set payload.no_payload_reason stating why
avoid: Leaving any message (including unchanged, pre-existing ones) with neither payload.contract nor payload.no_payload_reason
Empty or placeholder no_payload_reason used only to satisfy the check while the message actually carries data
why: Interlocking messages are integration points between participants; an untyped payload leaves the handoff ambiguous, and downstream payload checks (contract body, registry membership) presuppose a typed payload.
evidence: For each interlocking message, payload.contract or payload.no_payload_reason is present
verifier_detail: Term payload_typed: each message declares payload.contract or payload.no_payload_reason
Validation family: presence; template: conditional_requirement; variant: planner_train_interlocking_message_payload_typed
Phase: CONFIRM; enforcement: confirm-blocking; subject_kind: interlocking
Failure evidence fields: interlocking_id, message_id, payload, reason
